layout: float32 x5 per star: x, y, z, Vmag, B-V (brightest first)
frame: Mars equatorial: z = Mars north pole, x = ascending node of Mars's equator on the ICRF equator (J2000)

prime_meridian.note: viewer rotates the sky by W(t) about z so the planet faces the right stars for the current date

catalogue: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), NASA HEASARC table bsc5p
citation: Hoffleit & Warren 1991, The Bright Star Catalogue (5th rev. ed.), NASA HEASARC; Mars pole/W: Archinal et al. 2011, Celest. Mech. Dyn. Astr. 109
